nodes.description: external pure function compute(uint256 x) returns(uint256 result) that evaluates a Pedersen hash column polynomial in x using Horner's method
function parameter x, the evaluation point of the polynomial and the multiplier of every Horner step
named return variable result, used as the running accumulator across the batched Horner iterations
local constant PRIME = 0x800000000000011000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 used as the modular field prime
inline assembly block performing unchecked modular arithmetic (add/mulmod chains, 7 Horner steps per statement) over the field PRIME
final reduction return result % PRIME, which returns the modular result out of the assembly-computed value

edges.reason: The body of compute executes the inline assembly Horner evaluation block
The body of compute executes the final modulo reduction before returning
Parameter x is fed into every mulmod step of the assembly Horner chain as the multiplier
PRIME is used as the modulus argument of each mulmod inside the assembly block
The assembly block assigns the accumulated Horner value back into the local accumulator result
The accumulator result is read by the final modulo reduction operation
PRIME is used as the modulus of the final result % PRIME reduction
The reduced value produced by the modulo operation is returned as the function output

normalization_plan.reason: x is a non-core parameter consumed only by the unchecked assembly arithmetic block, so it can be folded into that unsafe_operation
result is a non-core local accumulator written and read solely inside the assembly Horner block (and consumed by the final reduction), so it can be folded into that unsafe_operation
PRIME is a non-core local constant used only as the modular field modulus of the arithmetic reduction, so it can be folded into the final reduction unsafe_operation
